Do you want to build a model that changes customer experience? Do you actually want to see your ideas, your pipelines, your architecture, your experiment really affect the business? If so, Chewy Search & Recommendations team is hiring!

We use the best machine learning techniques to simplify product discovery for animal lovers looking for their pet needs on Chewy.com. Our outstanding multi-disciplinary team of data scientists, data engineers, software/front-end engineers, and product managers work together to power personalized recommendations and search for pet parents.

Our mission is to make Chewy a trusted partner who meets pet-parents’ needs in an intuitively personalized and friction-free way. The team has single threaded ownership of the space allowing us to decide impactful products that we can experiment with, measure with metrics, and deliver and improve value to our customers.

We are hiring a Machine Learning Engineer/Data Scientist in either Bellevue, WA, Boston, MA or remote. In this position, you will work on all stages of model development from idea, analysis, architecture, pipeline, tuning, experimentation, and feedback loop. Your work will directly impact millions of customers who shop for their furry friends every day. This team focuses on learning, and on working together as a team to not only deploy model to production but also advance our modeling technique.

• You will partner peer MLE, Program Managers, Merchandizing, along with top engineers at Chewy.

• Formalizing assumptions about how models are encouraged to behave, crafting definitions of outliers, developing methods to systematically identify these outliers, and explaining why they are reasonable or identifying fixes for them.
• Presenting verbally and in writing to business customers with different levels of technical knowledge, educating them about our research, as well as sharing insights and recommendations.
• Work with a team of incredible people who are passionate about data science, machine learning, search & personalization.

What You'll Need:
• An advanced degree (Undergrad, M.S. or equivalent experience) in Operations Research, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Data Science or related field or 10 + years of proven experience crafting optimization and machine learning solutions for large scale applications.
• Ability to understand and apply sophisticated mathematics and DS methodologies.
• Experience in building distributed pipeline, tuning, optimizing and evaluation.
• Experience with different techniques that include Predictive Models (Time Series and Regression), Linear, NLP/NLU, Search, Ranking and LLM & generative AI.
• Ability to translate complex data sets and research into simple business recommendations.
• Experience growing junior data science team members.

• Experience in e-commerce or retail.

Now our SaaS technology is fueling a new era in the healthcare industry, with dynamic systems that change the way people receive care in settings outside of the hospital-and tools that work every day to help people stay well, longer.We have one of the largest actionable datasets in the industry, creating a complete view of people as they move between care settings. This is how we empower providers-with vital insight to deliver the care people need, right when they need it.

We're also ensuring that our health solutions connect to other companies' networks. Because when objectives align, everyone wins. And as we work today to drive better care and lower costs, we're developing more personalized solutions for tomorrow, utilizing machine learning, intelligent care paths, and predictive protocols. If you are an innovator who wants to make an impact we want to talk to you! We have exciting opportunities supporting Brightree by ResMed and MatrixCare by ResMed!

Let's talk about the team

As a Machine Learning Product Architect, you will play a pivotal role in our dynamic team, leading the way in the design and development of cutting-edge machine learning architectures for our SaaS products. At the core of our operations, our team focuses on experimentation, implementation, and enhancing AI-driven solutions that are integral to our product offerings, building smarter and more scalable data products. You will be responsible for the architecture's design, executing enhancements, mitigating risks, and addressing complex development and scalability challenges in AI technologies. Your expertise in applying rigorous machine learning engineering principles in a constantly innovating landscape will be crucial. Additionally, your role includes cross-functional collaboration with Product Engineering teams to ensure our software solutions effectively scale AI, reinforcing the smarter and scalable nature of data products.

Let's talk about the role

As a Machine Learning Product Architect, you will be responsible for the end-to-end architecture of machine learning solutions that empower our software products with advanced AI capabilities. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams including business product managers, data scientists, machine learning engineers, and software engineers to design and implement scalable machine learning systems. Your work will enable the integration of model training and inference in production environments, ensuring that both the data source and output are optimized for performance and accuracy. You will also work with leadership to communicate and demonstrate the value and impact of machine learning architectures.
• Design robust machine learning architectures that facilitate model training and real-time inference, ensuring that they are scalable, maintainable, and integrate seamlessly with existing software products.

• Provide technical leadership in machine learning infrastructure, establishing best practices for model versioning, monitoring, and deployment.
• Evaluate and incorporate modern technologies and frameworks to enhance the machine learning lifecycle within our products.
• Participate in and set up Proof of Concepts (POCs) to demonstrate proposed solutions.
• Advocate for and design data governance and security strategies that comply with industry standards and protect sensitive data.
• Design and implement machine learning inference APIs to enable software products to leverage AI capabilities.
• Facilitate the creation of a continuous integration/continuous MLOps deployment (CI/CD) pipeline for machine learning models, ensuring rapid and safe deployment of model updates.
• Oversee the performance tuning of machine learning models and the infrastructure they run on to ensure optimal efficiency and cost-effectiveness.
• Serve as a subject matter expert on machine learning within the organization, mentoring peers and stakeholders on the latest trends and best practices.

Let's talk about qualifications and experience
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field with 8+ years' experience
• Proven experience in designing and implementing machine learning systems in production.
• Strong understanding of machine learning algorithms, data modeling, and data pipeline workflows.
• Experience with machine learning frameworks and cloud services (e.g. AWS).
• Proficiency in programming languages such as Python.
• Knowledge of software architecture principles and design patterns.
• A strong portfolio of successful machine learning projects.

Preferred
• Certifications in cloud architecture or machine learning technologies

job_description:
About Us:

RNET Technologies is a cutting-edge computer science research company specializing in high-performance computing (HPC) and machine learning (ML) solutions. Our team of passionate scientists and engineers collaborates on groundbreaking projects that push the boundaries of tensor computation including numerical simulation and machine learning applications. If you’re excited about advancing the field of computational science, we’d love to hear from you!

Position Overview:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Scientific Software Developer to join our cutting-edge research initiatives. In this position you will work on challenging problems related to machine learning, numerical simulation, fluid dynamics, and HPC system implementations. This position offers a unique blend of scientific research, software development, and practical application, with opportunities for collaboration with leading universities and government labs.

Responsibilities:
• Conduct cutting-edge research in high-performance computing, numerical simulation, and machine learning.
• Develop and implement novel algorithms and techniques for solving complex scientific and engineering problems.
• Implement and optimize numerical simulations for fluid dynamics, structural analysis, and other scientific domains.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into HPC workflows.
• Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in HPC, scientific/numerical simulation, ML Frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX), and related technologies.
• Publish research findings in reputable conferences and journals.
• Contribute to a collaborative research environment including research partners (leading universities and government laboratories) and stakeholders.

Qualifications:
• M.S. in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or other engineering fields with a strong computational physics and/or Machine Learning.
• Strong background in high-performance computing, parallel programming, and numerical methods.
• Solid programming skills in Python, C++, Rust, CUDA, SYCL, OpenCL, and/or OpenMP.
• Excellent problem-solving abilities.
• Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Ph.D. in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or other engineering fields with a strong computational physics and/or Machine Learning.
• Good understanding of computational linear algebra and applied mathematics.
• Experience with distributed computing and cloud-based HPC platforms.
• Contributions to open-source projects related to HPC and/or ML.
• Experience with fluid dynamics simulations, finite element analysis, or computational physics.
• Proficiency in at least one popular Machine Learning Frameworks.

Why Join RNET Technologies?
• Work on impactful research projects with real-world applications.
• Collaborate with leading experts in HPC and ML at both government laboratories and leading research universities.
• Competitive compensation and benefits package.
• Flexible work environment and opportunities for professional growth.
• Make a difference in advancing computational science and technology.

If you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of scientific computing and want to be part of an innovative team, apply now! Send your curriculum vitae and cover letter to careers@RNET-Tech.com.
